# Cue 0.9.1 — Faster search and smoother settings / 搜尋效能與設定體驗改善
## English
Cue 0.9.1 improves responsiveness and existing workflows after a code, performance, and interface review. Window controls are being planned and are not included.
- **Long text stays responsive:** large pasted queries skip expensive app matching and search caching while keeping the original text for Google and GPT actions. Ordinary short queries still update immediately, without a debounce. - **Settings preserve your work:** opening settings keeps the current page and input. GPT stops an active request and retains the text already received; closing settings returns to it without automatically retrying or incurring a new request. Late failures from an older app or system action no longer reclaim focus. - **Clipboard preview:** use **Preview / Command+Y** to read the selected item's complete text, then Esc to return. Pending copies are cancelled when entering settings, changing the query/selection, leaving the page or losing focus. Clipboard publication runs off the UI thread; a write already started cannot safely be rolled back. List text is also easier to read. - **Clearer controls:** the empty launcher remains minimal; entered text exposes an **Actions Command+K** button. General Settings now has two compact groups with an accessible close button. GPT's **Save Model** explicitly applies edits; Done closes the page, while translation selections apply immediately. - **Keyboard and emoji fixes:** global-hotkey settings reject shortcuts reserved for result numbers, clipboard actions and standard text editing. Existing conflicting saved shortcuts fall back to Option+Space. Emoji such as text-style hearts and coffee cups can be found without changing the copied emoji.
### Install or upgrade
[Download Cue 0.9.1](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.9.1/Cue-0.9.1-universal.dmg) · [Checksums](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.9.1/SHA256SUMS.txt)
With Cue networking enabled, choose **Check for Updates…**, then **Install and Relaunch**. Or quit Cue, open the DMG, and replace Cue.app in your Applications folder. Reopen the installed app; settings, clipboard history and search learning are preserved. The installed location must be writable; do not run updates from the read-only DMG.
To build locally, install full Xcode with Swift 6 or later and complete its initial setup, then run:
```sh git clone https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue.git cd cue ./scripts/install-app.sh open "$HOME/Applications/Cue.app" ```
For later source updates, quit Cue, run `git pull --ff-only` and `./scripts/install-app.sh`, then reopen it. Source builds default to Cue-owned networking and automatic update checks off; official DMGs default to on. Explicit saved choices survive replacement. Installing an in-app update switches a source build to the published app. See the [source guide](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.9.1/docs/building.md).
### Verification and limits
Optimized tests use synthetic apps, private pasteboards, temporary preferences, mocked API responses and offscreen English/Traditional Chinese settings. They do not manipulate the operator's desktop or use personal credentials. In a synthetic long-query fixture, 268 KB input dropped from about 67 ms to below 0.1 ms on the main thread; this measures search-model work, not visible input-to-display latency. See [measurements](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.9.1/docs/performance-search.md).
The universal app targets macOS 14+ with Apple silicon and Intel binaries. Execution checks are on Apple silicon / macOS 27.0 / Xcode 27. Intel and other macOS versions, another Mac's first download, a complete public Sparkle update installation, real GPT replies/API latency/Keychain authorization, global focus transitions, and sleep/lock/login cycles were not revalidated for this release. Non-QWERTY Command+K/Command+E routing remains unchanged.
Cue is ad hoc-signed, without Developer ID signing or Apple notarization. Follow the [app-specific installation guide](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.9.1/docs/installation.md) if macOS blocks first launch. Chinese text replacement requires Accessibility permission; updating an ad hoc-signed app may require granting permission again.
## 正體中文
Cue 0.9.1 根據程式碼、效能與介面檢查，改善操作反應與既有流程。 視窗調整功能正在規劃，本版尚未包含。
- **長文字輸入更順暢：**貼入大量文字時，略過昂貴的 App 比對與搜尋快取， 保留原文供 Google／GPT 動作使用。一般短查詢仍即時更新，不加入等待延遲。 - **進設定保留操作內容：**保留原頁面與輸入；GPT 會停止進行中的請求，並 保留已收到的文字。關閉設定後返回原內容，不會自動重試或送出新的計費請求。 舊 App／系統操作的延遲失敗訊息，也不再搶回焦點。 - **剪貼簿全文預覽：**按**預覽／Command+Y**閱讀所選記錄全文，Esc 返回。 開啟設定、改變搜尋或選取、離開頁面及失去焦點，都會取消尚未完成的拷貝。 剪貼簿寫入移到背景；已開始的寫入無法安全回復。清單文字也更容易閱讀。 - **更明確的控制：**空白主視窗維持極簡，有輸入時顯示**動作 Command+K**。 一般設定整理成兩組，完成按鈕保持可用。GPT 的**儲存模型**明確套用修改， **完成**只關閉頁面；翻譯方向選單立即套用。 - **快捷鍵與 Emoji 修正：**全域快捷鍵不能與結果編號、剪貼簿動作及基本文字 編輯衝突；既有衝突設定會回復 Option+Space。文字樣式的愛心、咖啡杯等 Emoji 現在也能搜尋，拷貝出的 Emoji 內容維持原樣。
### 安裝或升級
[下載 Cue 0.9.1](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.9.1/Cue-0.9.1-universal.dmg) · [檢查碼](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/releases/download/v0.9.1/SHA256SUMS.txt)
允許 Cue 使用網路後，選擇**檢查更新⋯**，再安裝並重新啟動（**Install and Relaunch**）。也可先結束 Cue，開啟 DMG，替換應用程式資料夾內的 Cue.app， 再開啟安裝好的版本。原設定、剪貼簿記錄與搜尋學習資料會保留；安裝位置必須 可寫入，不能直接在唯讀 DMG 內更新。
自行建置需要內含 Swift 6 以上的完整 Xcode，先完成首次啟動設定，再執行：
```sh git clone https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue.git cd cue ./scripts/install-app.sh open "$HOME/Applications/Cue.app" ```
之後更新原始碼版時，先結束 Cue，再執行 `git pull --ff-only` 與 `./scripts/install-app.sh`，然後重新開啟。自行建置版預設關閉 Cue 自行連網 及自動檢查更新，正式 DMG 預設開啟；明確儲存的選擇會保留。從 App 內安裝 更新會換成發布版，詳見[原始碼指引](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.9.1/docs/building.md)。
### 驗證與限制
最佳化測試使用模擬 App、專用測試剪貼簿、暫時設定、模擬 API 回應，以及 不顯示在桌面的英文／正體中文設定頁；不操作使用者桌面或使用個人金鑰。 在模擬長查詢測量中，268 KB 輸入的主執行緒耗時由約 67 毫秒降到 0.1 毫秒 以下。這是搜尋模型的運算時間，不是按鍵到畫面的總延遲，詳見 [測量紀錄](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.9.1/docs/performance-search.md)。
通用版目標為 macOS 14+，包含 Apple silicon 與 Intel 執行檔。執行檢查環境為 Apple silicon／macOS 27.0／Xcode 27。本次未重新驗證 Intel、其他 macOS 版本、 另一台 Mac 首次下載、完整公開 Sparkle 更新安裝、真實 GPT 回答／API 延遲／ 鑰匙圈授權、跨 App 焦點切換，以及睡眠／鎖定／登入啟動循環。 非 QWERTY 配置的 Command+K／Command+E 路由維持原狀。
Cue 使用 ad hoc 簽章，沒有 Developer ID 簽署，也未經 Apple 公證。若 macOS 阻擋首次開啟，請依針對 Cue 的[安裝說明](https://github.com/hsiuhsiu/cue/blob/v0.9.1/docs/installation.md) 操作。簡繁文字取代需要輔助使用權限；更新 ad hoc 簽章 App 後，可能需要重新授權。
